speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine or stool, or any yellowing of your skin or eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you noticed any recent changes in your bowel habits, such as increased frequency, diarrhea, or blood in the stool? Additionally, have you experienced any abdominal pain, particularly in the upper right quadrant?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
You have scleral icterus and scratch marks, confirming jaundice and severe itching. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, this presentation is highly suggestive of Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. I will request specific tests to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: MRCP
REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Tests: Bilirubin_Total: 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct: 0.9 mg/dL, Alkaline_Phosphatase: 460 U/L, AST: 75 U/L, ALT: 78 U/L, Anti-Nuclear_Antibody: Negative, Antimitochondrial_Antibodies: Negative. MRCP: NOT IN DATA. NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The MRCP result appears to be missing or normal, which is unexpected for PSC, so I need to clarify your risk factors for viral hepatitis. Have you ever received blood transfusions, used intravenous drugs, or had any known exposure to Hepatitis B or C?

REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_B_and_C_Panel
REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hepatitis_B_and_C_Panel: NOT IN DATA. NORMAL READINGS. Abdominal_Ultrasound: Findings: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The abdominal ultrasound showing bile duct thickening and dilatation, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis and cholestatic liver enzyme pattern, strongly supports the diagnosis. I will now finalize my assessment based on these findings.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
